question: How many PTO days do I get per year?
answer: Up to 5 unused PTO days carry over to the next calendar year. Days above 5 expire on December 31.

question: How many vacation days can I take in my first three months?
answer: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of paid time off (PTO) per year, earned at 1.25 days per month. New hires start accruing PTO on their first day of work.

question: How far in advance should I request a week off?
answer: Submit PTO requests in the HR system at least 2 weeks in advance for absences of 3 or more days. Your manager approves or declines the request within 3 business days.

question: Do unused vacation days roll over to next year?
answer: Up to 5 unused PTO days carry over to the next calendar year. Days above 5 expire on December 31.

question: How many sick days do I get?
answer: Employees receive 6 paid sick days per year, separate from PTO. Sick days can be used from the first day of work and do not require advance notice, but you should tell your manager as early as possible.

question: How many paid holidays does the company have?
answer: observes 10 paid company holidays each year. The holiday calendar is published in the HR portal every December.

question: What is the deadline to sign up for benefits?
answer: New hires must enroll in benefits within 30 days of their start date. If you miss the 30-day window, you can only enroll during the annual open enrollment period or after a qualifying life event.

question: When does my health insurance start?
answer: Medical, dental and vision coverage starts on the first day of the month after your start date. If you start on the first day of a month, coverage starts that day.

question: What medical plans can I choose from?
answer: Example Co. offers two medical plans: a PPO plan and a high-deductible health plan (HDHP) with a health savings account (HSA).

question: Does the company put money in my HSA?
answer: offers two medical plans: a PPO plan and a high-deductible health plan (HDHP) with a health savings account (HSA). The company contributes 500 dollars per year to the HSA for employees enrolled in the HDHP.

question: Can I add my spouse to dental coverage?
answer: Dental and vision plans are optional and can be added for yourself, your spouse or partner, and dependents.

question: What is the 401k match?
answer: Employees can join the 401(k) plan from their first paycheck. The match vests immediately.

question: I just had a baby, can I change my benefits?
answer: Marriage, birth or adoption of a child, and loss of other coverage are qualifying life events. You have 30 days after the event to change your benefit elections.

question: How often do we get paid?
answer: Your first paycheck arrives on the first regular payday after you complete one full pay period. Depending on your start date, this can be 2 to 4 weeks after you start.

question: When will I get my first paycheck?
answer: Your first paycheck arrives on the first regular payday after you complete one full pay period. Depending on your start date, this can be 2 to 4 weeks after you start.

question: How do I set up direct deposit?
answer: Set up direct deposit in the HR system during your first week. Until direct deposit is active, a paper check is mailed to your home address.

question: Where do I fill out my W-4?
answer: Complete your federal W-4 form in the HR system before your first payday. You can update your withholding at any time.

question: Where can I find my pay stubs?
answer: Pay stubs are available in the HR system on each payday and are kept there for 7 years.

question: Which days do I need to be in the office?
citation: time_off.md > Using PTO in the first 90 days
answer: New hires may use up to 3 days of accrued PTO during their first 90 days. Requests longer than 3 days in the first 90 days need manager approval.

question: Can I work from home during my first week?
answer: Set up direct deposit in the HR system during your first week. Until direct deposit is active, a paper check is mailed to your home address.

question: Can I switch to a fully remote role?
answer: Fully remote work is allowed only for roles posted as remote. Changing to fully remote requires approval from your manager and HR.

question: Is there a stipend for my home office?
answer: Hybrid and remote employees receive a one-time home office stipend of 300 dollars, claimed through the expense system within 60 days of the start date.

question: Can I work from India for two weeks?
answer: Working from outside your home country, even for a short period, requires HR approval in advance because of tax and legal rules.

question: When will I get my laptop?
answer: Every new hire receives a company laptop on day one. IT ships laptops to remote hires 3 business days before their start date.

question: How do I get my email login?
answer: Your email, chat and HR system accounts are created before your first day. IT sends login instructions to your personal email the day before you start.

question: Do I need to set up MFA?
answer: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) must be set up on your first day before you can access company systems.

question: I lost my work laptop, what should I do?
answer: Report a lost or stolen laptop or phone to the IT help desk within 24 hours so the device can be locked remotely.

question: How do I request new software?
answer: Request additional software through the IT service portal. Most requests are approved within 2 business days.

question: What training do I have to finish in my first month?
answer: Your manager assigns role-specific training during your first week. Progress is tracked in the learning system.

question: Who assigns my role training?
answer: Your manager assigns role-specific training during your first week. Progress is tracked in the learning system.

question: Will I have a buddy to help me?
answer: Every new hire is paired with an onboarding buddy from their team for the first 90 days. The buddy answers day-to-day questions and helps you meet people.

question: When are my check-ins with my manager?
answer: Managers hold check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days to review goals, training progress and any questions.

question: How long do I have to submit an expense?
answer: Submit expenses in the expense system within 30 days of the purchase, with an itemized receipt for any expense over 25 dollars.

question: When will I be reimbursed for expenses?
answer: Your manager approves expenses, and approved expenses are reimbursed in the next payroll run.

question: What is the meal limit when traveling?
answer: When traveling for work, meals are covered up to 75 dollars per day.

question: How do I book a flight for a work trip?
answer: Book flights and hotels through the company travel portal. Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours.

question: What should I wear to the office?
answer: The dress code is business casual in the office. Teams that meet customers may have additional guidelines.

question: How do I report a concern anonymously?
answer: You can report a concern to your manager, to HR, or anonymously through the ethics hotline. Reports are reviewed confidentially and retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith is prohibited.
